messages.author: Malinok
messages.text: There should be a war history that everyone can access.   Keeps wars and winnings public.  It is also a great reference tool.

messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text: I think, and correct me if i am wrong, but he wants similar to what pnw did, total wars, wins and losses tracked for public view.

messages.author: Malinok
messages.text: Details on what was won/lost in the war.  The other details is a bonus.

messages.author: Cario
messages.text:
yeah i think it should be publicly accessible, the entire war history. what attacks were done, what units were lost, what was destroyed
then u can learn from wars and also notice anomalies and such
